dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, could I trouble you to keep gathering the roaming spirits over the next few days? Just make sure to use this censer — Granny already applied her spell to it.

response.speaker: Ororon
response.text: Oh, you liked playing with that, huh? Feel free to try it again whenever you want. There should be some other clairvoyance records you can arrange on a woven scroll. It's pretty fun.

response.speaker: Ororon
response.text: Don't worry about Granny. I'm sure she only left it here so you can get some practice.

response.speaker: Ororon
response.text: The Mare Jivari? Terrible place to grow vegetables, for one thing.

response.speaker: Ororon
response.text: And if you're wondering how I would know that — well, it's because Granny told me. If you want to know more, you should probably ask her when she gets back.

response.speaker: Ororon
response.text: She has some scrolls on the subject in her house, but my rule is: If you can't grow vegetables there, I'm not interested. So I've never given them a second look. Truly sorry.
